PLAN "PCOS Body Composition & Insulin Sensitivity (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve body composition and insulin sensitivity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Technique" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
